title: Oracle Support   Start saving costs on your technical support renewal
description: It's no secret that support maintenance costs are the main source of revenue for Oracle and often form the major part of end users' software budget. Support maintenance is typically calculated at 22% of the (net) license fee and indexed with 3-4% year over year. Many end users however don't realize that they are spending too much on the support maintenance fee. The good news is that there a number of things you can do to keep these costs under control and start saving money.  In this webinar we talk about why many Oracle customers pay too much for support maintenance and what you can do to prevent spending more than necessary. We also share some inspiring success stories of our customers.
